profile.text: Ukusik, formerly of the Grypherburg underground society 'the Unbound'. She joined the Grypherburg branch of Rhodes Island at Operator Zima's recommendation, and works in intelligence gathering and first-aid. She receives regular Oripathy treatment and general education at Rhodes Island HQ at the request of Leto, who serves as her guardian.
